title: Retain created asyncio tasks
why: The event loop keeps weak task references, so a discarded task can disappear before completion and its exception can be lost.
suggestion: Await the task, retain it until completion, or use asyncio.TaskGroup for structured concurrency.
limitations: Only discarded direct asyncio.create_task and asyncio.ensure_future expression statements are reported.
Imported aliases, custom task factories, and references retained indirectly by wrappers are not inferred.
